newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Senate panel votes to block overtime rule.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Senate panel votes to block overtime rule.

text.p: A California Senate panel on Wednesday voted to reverse controversial employee overtime rules opposed by unions and other labor groups.
The Senate Industrial Relations Committee voted 4-3 to send the bill to the Appropriations Committee for review.
A similar bill stalled in the Assembly Labor and Employment Committee after amendments were added.
Both bills seek to overturn rules approved in April by the state's Industrial Welfare Commission.
Under the new rules adopted by the commission, many private-sector workers would only be eligible for overtime once they have worked at least 40 hours in a week.
Under the old rule, a worker became eligible for overtime on a daily basis after putting in eight hours.
